Add an on-demand credential prompt to the Vue client for git remote operations. Project path: /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform, client project is client/ (codx-junior-ui).

CONTEXT: client/src/api/modules/repo.js (~line 727) has push() (and fetch/pull) that call POST /git/repo/{push|fetch|pull} with an empty body. The backend is being changed in parallel to (a) accept an OPTIONAL credential object {username, password, token} in the JSON body only, and (b) answer a failed-auth call with HTTP 400 and body {"detail": {"requires_credentials": true, "remote": "...", "operation": "push", "message": "..."}}.
